text: ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti . atha kho mayaṃ bhante yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamimhā 1 upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipucchimhā 2 . tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā ānandena imehi ākārehi imehi liṅgehi 3 imehi byañjanehi attho vibhattoti . paṇḍito bhikkhave ānando mahāpañño bhikkhave ānando mañcepi tumeha bhikkhave etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha ahampi taṃ evameva byākareyyaṃ yathā 4 taṃ ānandena byākataṃ eso cevassa 5 attho evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti . catutthaṃ .
